question: Which country has veto power in the United Nations?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The United Nations Security Council is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations.

 
 
• Its headquarter is in New York, United States.
 
• It was established on 24 October 1945.
 
• The** five permanent members **have been given **veto power** to veto the original resolution.
 
• The five permanent members are **China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States.​**
